## 🚀 How to Install

1. Download **`MirrorTab-__VERSION__.zip`** below.
2. Unzip the folder.
3. Go to `chrome://extensions/` in Chrome.
4. Enable **Developer mode**.
5. Click **Load unpacked** and select the folder.

Updating from an earlier version: unzip over the same folder, then click the reload icon on the MirrorTab card in `chrome://extensions/`. Reload any tabs that were already open so they pick up the new version.
